**Regulation to analyze:** NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 (Release 5.2.0) control baseline, NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 (Release 5.2.0, Aug 27, 2025)
**Why:** State and local agencies face overlapping federal data-owner mandates (IRS Pub 1075 for FTI, CJIS Security Policy v6.x for CJI, CMS for Medicaid/exchange data, SLCGP plans). Pub 1075 explicitly uses NIST SP 800-53 controls, and CJISSECPOL v6 is modernized onto the 800-53 control structure. A single 800-53 Moderate-based gap analysis with Pub 1075 and CJIS overlays covers the binding requirements most efficiently. If only one mandate applies, use it directly (e.g., CJIS for a police department).
